note: Algorithm design conventions of the passive-first climate controller. They are not agronomic values and not measurements. Crop thresholds (temperature range, critical heat/frost, radiation, soil water, shading reduction) are read per stage from crop_config.json; equipment (capacity, COP, fan power) is supplied by the user per request.

design.meaning: fractions of the hot band [max_temp_c .. critical_heat_c] of the current stage at which the passive vents reach full opening and the extractors reach full speed; HVAC cooling covers the rest. Active equipment therefore only works once the passive tier is exhausted. hvac_gain (0..1] is the fraction of the distance between the HVAC-free equilibrium temperature (estimated from the greenhouse conductance and the HVAC power of the previous step) and the target that the HVAC power closes in one step.
